name: groupTotals
summary: Group rows by a key and total a set of numeric FIELDS — per group AND overall — in ONE pass. The back half of every 'spend by X' rollup. The fields to sum are DATA (a record of named numeric accessors), so adding a tracked metric is one entry, not editing three reducers. Group subtotals and the grand total come from the SAME traversal, so they cannot drift apart — the bug the hand-written three-separate-reductions version has. Groups in first-seen order (the one order needing no opinion; a caller wanting another sorts the result). Harvested from the Fleet page's cost panel (#3462/#3465), rolling per-worker token usage up to fleet totals + a by-model breakdown.
